title: HHQG ameliorates acute liver injury (ALI) by inhibiting NLRP3 activation through RASD1-mediated regulation of the PKCdelta-NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
authors: Ma, Chunli; Wang, Linghong; Cao, Lili; Zhao, Linyun; Zhang, Xin; Ma, Chengyou; Lian, Hua; Bao, Xiufang; Eerde, Mutu; Buren, Qiqige; Tong, He; Dai, Lili; Amu, Guleng; Bao, Yulong; Hong, Mei; Wang, Li
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药HHQG通过RASD1调控PKCdelta-NF-kappaB通路抑制NLRP3改善肝损伤，虽含分子对接但对象为药物-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Acute liver injury (ALI) is a prevalent hepatic condition that poses significant risks to both life and overall health. Traditional Mongolian medicine utilizes Honghua Qinggan Thirteen-Flavor Pills (HHQG) as a primary formula for dispelling liver heat, illustrating both an extensive application in clinical settings and notable therapeutic effectiveness for treating liver ailments such as hepatitis and liver failure. Nevertheless, the molecular mechanisms underpinning the hepatoprotective properties of HHQG remain inadequately understood.We employed a CCl(4)-induced mouse model of liver injury alongside network pharmacology analysis, molecular docking studies, and cellular assays to dissect the effects and mechanisms of action of HHQG. Our findings demonstrated that HHQG significantly improved CCl(4)-induced liver injury in mice, reducing pathological damage and inflammatory factors. Network pharmacology identified 184 overlapping targets, 6 key genes, and 5 key active components in HHQG. Molecular docking confirmed the binding affinity of these components to RASD1. Gene expression analysis in liver tissue revealed a positive correlation between mRNA expression of RASD1 and NLRP3. Cell experiments demonstrated the role of RASD1 in regulating NLRP3 inflammasome and inflammatory factors. Pretreatment of HHQG attenuated LPS-induced inflammatory response and the activation of PKCdelta-NF-kappaB signaling pathway. In the CCl(4)-induced liver injury model, HHQG significantly reduced NLRP3, RASD1, and PKCdelta-NF-kappaB expression.This study revealed that HHQG effectively mitigates CCl(4)-induced liver injury by inhibiting the activation of NLRP3 inflammasome by regulating the PKCdelta-NF-kappaB signaling pathway via RASD1. These findings provide novel theoretical support for the rational application of HHQG as a potential hepatoprotective agent.
abstract_zh:
急性肝损伤（ALI）是一种常见的肝脏疾病，对生命和整体健康构成重大风险。传统蒙药红花清肝十三味丸（HHQG）作为清肝热的主要方剂，在临床中应用广泛，对肝炎、肝衰竭等肝脏疾病显示出显著的治疗效果。然而，HHQG保肝作用背后的分子机制仍未被充分阐明。

我们采用CCl(4)诱导的小鼠肝损伤模型，结合网络药理学分析、分子对接研究和细胞实验，以解析HHQG的作用及机制。研究结果表明，HHQG显著改善了CCl(4)诱导的小鼠肝损伤，减轻了病理损伤和炎症因子。网络药理学鉴定了HHQG中184个重叠靶点、6个关键基因和5个关键活性成分。分子对接证实了这些成分与RASD1的结合亲和力。肝组织中的基因表达分析显示，RASD1的mRNA表达与NLRP3呈正相关。细胞实验证明了RASD1在调控NLRP3炎症小体和炎症因子中的作用。HHQG预处理减弱了LPS诱导的炎症反应及PKCdelta-NF-kappaB信号通路的激活。在CCl(4)诱导的肝损伤模型中，HHQG显著降低了NLRP3、RASD1和PKCdelta-NF-kappaB的表达。

本研究揭示，HHQG通过RASD1调控PKCdelta-NF-kappaB信号通路，抑制NLRP3炎症小体的激活，从而有效缓解CCl(4)诱导的肝损伤。这些发现为HHQG作为潜在保肝剂的合理应用提供了新的理论支持。
